bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, the FIFO error vectors for the raw entropy input FIFO and the observe FIFO had their write-error bit hardwired to 1'b0. As a result, a write to a full FIFO was not reported as a FIFO write error, so the corresponding ERR_CODE write-error status and fatal alert condition could not be triggered for these FIFOs. The spec requires internal FIFO write errors, including writes to a full FIFO, to be detected and reported. The fix replaces the constant zero with the actual write-to-full condition for each FIFO.
bug_info.fix_hint: For each FIFO error vector, compute the write-error bit as the conjunction of the FIFO push/valid signal and the FIFO full signal, e.g. bit [2] should be (sfifo_esrng_push && sfifo_esrng_full) for the raw entropy input FIFO and (sfifo_observe_push && sfifo_observe_full) for the observe FIFO, instead of tying that bit to 1'b0.
